card.architecture: Rectified-flow DiT (T5-XXL + CLIP-L), guidance-distilled, whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through FLUX.1-dev using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn with FLUX's prompt following, detail and photorealism. Ideal for pushing an off-model or low-fidelity image up to FLUX quality while keeping its layout.
card.commercial_use: no (outputs usable per license; model commercial use needs BFL license)
card.pick_when: You want to redraw the WHOLE image (not a masked region) through FLUX.1-dev, keeping the composition.

prompt.guidance: Describe the finished picture in long, descriptive sentences. Lower the redraw strength to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let FLUX reinterpret more.
prompt.example: A close-up portrait of an elderly fisherman with a weathered face and thick grey beard, yellow raincoat, standing on a wooden dock at golden hour, soft rim lighting, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 85mm lens
prompt.instructions:
Type the FULL description of the picture you want — this is a whole-frame re-render, not an edit instruction, and FLUX.1-dev follows natural-language prose.
28 steps, euler/simple, distilled guidance 3.5 (real CFG stays 1).
'Redraw strength' (denoise) controls how far the result drifts from the source: ~0.3-0.5 keeps the source's structure and mostly restyles it, ~0.7+ substantially reinvents it.
The source is normalized to the configured ~1 MP working budget with its aspect ratio preserved, so low-resolution inputs gain a larger VAE grid and oversized inputs are reduced before sampling.
Negative prompts are inactive: the model is guidance-distilled and runs at CFG 1.

negative.note: Distilled guidance (effective CFG 1); negatives don't work.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a description; the whole frame is redrawn through FLUX.1-dev. 'Redraw strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: restyling / upgrading a whole image to FLUX quality while keeping its composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: redraw an entire image through FLUX.1-dev from a prompt, keeping composition (restyle / raise fidelity)
